mapper.select: SELECT M.id, M.sender_id AS senderId, S.user_name AS sender, M.receiver_id AS receiverId, R.user_name AS receiver, M.process_type AS processType, M.title, M.created_at AS createdAt FROM MAILS M INNER JOIN MEMBERS S ON M.sender_id = S.id INNER JOIN MEMBERS R ON M.receiver_id = R.id WHERE M.RECEIVER_ID = #{memberId} OR M.SENDER_ID = #{memberId} ORDER BY M.id DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MAILS ( SENDER_ID, RECEIVER_ID, POST_ID, PROCESS_TYPE, PROCESS_STATUS, TITLE, CONTENT, AMOUNT ) VALUES ( #{senderId}, #{receiverId}, #{postId}, #{processType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{processStatus, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{title}, #{content, jdbcType=CLOB}, #{amount} )
mapper.select: SELECT ID, SENDER_ID, RECEIVER_ID, POST_ID, PROCESS_TYPE, PROCESS_STATUS, TITLE, CONTENT, AMOUNT, CREATED_AT FROM MAILS WHERE ID = #{id}

SELECT M.id, M.sender_id AS senderId, TS.user_name AS sender, M.receiver_id AS receiverId, TR.user_name AS receiver, M.post_id AS postId, M.process_type AS processType, M.process_status AS processStatus, M.title, M.content, M.amount, M.created_at AS createdAt FROM MAILS M INNER JOIN MEMBERS TS ON M.sender_id = TS.id INNER JOIN MEMBERS TR ON M.receiver_id = TR.id WHERE M.id = #{id}
